Below is a conversation between two people: Audrey and Andrew. The conversation takes place over multiple days and the date of each conversation is wriiten at the beginning of the conversation.


DATE: 1:10 pm on 27 March, 2023
CONVERSATION:
Audrey said, "Hey Andrew! Good to see ya! What's been up since we last talked?"

Andrew said, "Hey Audrey! So, I started a new job as a Financial Analyst last week - it's been quite a change from my previous job. How about you? Anything interesting happening?"

Audrey said, "Congrats on the new job! So I got these new collars and tags for my dogs - so cute!"

Andrew said, "Thanks! That sounds cute. Can I see a picture?"

Audrey said, "Sure! See them with their new collars, cute right?"
 and shared a photography of two dogs are standing in the grass with their mouths open.
Andrew said, "Cute little guys! What are their names and how long have you had them?"

Audrey said, "I've had them for 3 years! Their names are Pepper, Precious and Panda. I can't live without my little ones!"

Andrew said, "That's awesome! Have you always wanted a dog, even with living in the city? Can they still go on adventures?"

Audrey said, "Absolutely! They're city dogs and we explore all the time. They love trying out new parks and trails. We go on adventures together very often."

Andrew said, "Wow, sounds like they make life so awesome! Kinda jealous of all those fun outings with them."

Audrey said, "They really do! It's great how much happiness they bring. Do you have any pets?"

Andrew said, "No, no pets right now. But I do love animals."

Audrey said, "That's great to hear! Animals are truly amazing. Do you have a favorite animal?"

Andrew said, "I've always been awed by birds. Their power to soar and explore new spots is amazing."

Audrey said, "Yeah, birds are amazing! I can imagine it feels incredible to soar and see the world from up high. Do you have a favorite type of bird?"

Andrew said, "Eagles have always mesmerized me; they're so strong and graceful!"
 and shared a photo of two birds flying in the sky with a sun shining behind them.
Audrey said, "Yeah they're beautiful. Do you go bird-watching? It must be awesome to see them up close."

Andrew said, "Haven't specifically gone out for bird-watching, but I do spot them when I hike."

Audrey said, "Nice, spotting pretty birds while hiking must be great. Do you have any favorite hiking spots?"

Andrew said, "Fox Hollow is a great trail to hike on weekends; the views are awesome!"

Audrey said, "Cool, gonna give it a try. Thanks for the suggestion!"

Andrew said, "No problem! Let me know how you like it. Have fun hiking!"

Audrey said, "Thanks! I'll let you know. Have a good one!"

Andrew said, "Take care and have a good one! See ya!"


DATE: 2:42 pm on 2 April, 2023
CONVERSATION:
Audrey said, "Hey Andrew, I got a surprise for you! We adopted another puppy called Pixie. She's SO cute! Isn't she just the cutest?"
 and shared a photo of a small white dog sitting on a carpet.
Andrew said, "That's awesome! Pixie is so cute! Did you ever check out that hiking spot we talked about last time?"

Audrey said, "Thanks! I know right? She's so cute! Pixie's been keeping us busy, so I haven't had a chance to check out that hiking spot yet."

Andrew said, "Yeah, I get it. A puppy really takes some work. Has she settled in okay? Is she getting along with the other pups?"

Audrey said, "Pixie's fitting in great! It took her a few days to get used to the other dogs, but now they're awesome friends. They love playing and exploring the house - so cute!
"
 and shared a photography of a dog playing with a group of other dogs.
Andrew said, "That's awesome! Is Pepper adjusting well to her?"

Audrey said, "Pepper took a bit to get used to her, but now they're always together!"
 and shared a photography of two dogs standing in the grass near a fence.
Andrew said, "That's great to hear! I'm considering getting a dog too, but it can be challenging finding a dog-friendly place in 

[... 96,297 characters omitted ...]

seek - they love it all!"
 and shared a photography of a dog playing with a frisbee in a room.
Andrew said, "Cool ideas! I think I'll give those activities a try with my pups. Thanks!"

Audrey said, "No problem, glad I could help. Let me know how it goes."

Andrew said, "Your advice and support really mean a lot to me! Thank you so much!"

Audrey said, "That's what friends are for - supporting each other. Your friendship means a lot to me. :)"


DATE: 9:02 am on 22 November, 2023
CONVERSATION:
Audrey said, "Hey Andrew! Long time no talk! Last Friday I took my fur kids to the pet salon - they were so psyched and their tails were wagging like crazy! It took a while for them to calm down, but all cut up they looked so cute! "

Andrew said, "Hey Audrey! Nice to hear from you. Sounds adorable! Do you have any pictures of them all groomed up?"

Audrey said, "Here's a pic of them, looking all groomed. Look at those shiny coats! To top it off, they were really good at the salon - I always worry about them in new places."
 and shared a photography of a dog is standing on a table with a leash.
Andrew said, "Wow, they look great! Love seeing them happy and calm in new places."

Audrey said, "Thanks! It means a lot to see them happy and settled in new places. I guess I'm doing a good job as a doggy mom then, haha! Have you taken your furry friends to the groomers yet?"

Andrew said, "No, we haven't got the chance to take them to the groomer yet. But will do that soon! So guess what, I can't help myself but to adpot another dog the other day. Here's a photo of the doggo!"
 and shared a photo of a woman feeding a dog hay in a barn.
Audrey said, "That's great news! What's the pups name?"

Andrew said, "It took us a while to decide, but we ended up going with 'Scout' for our pup - it seemed perfect for their adventurous spirit."

Audrey said, "That's a great name for your pup! Fits their adventurous spirit. What's Scout's first adventure gonna be?"

Andrew said, "Thanks! We're gonna take Scout, Toby, and Buddy to a nearby park. It's not big, but we can all have fun and get some fresh air!"

Audrey said, "Sounds like a great start for Scout! Start small, and gradually give them more exposure. They'll have a great time, just make sure to keep them leashed."
 and shared a photography of a dog running with a tennis ball in its mouth.
Andrew said, "Yeah, safety first! For now, we're keeping the new addition on a leash while they get used to being outside. That pic you of your dog at the park is so cute. So we got some essentials for their comfort and entertainment, like a bed, toys, and some puppy pads just in case. It's like their own little safe haven."

Audrey said, "Wow, that's so great that you two are creating a safe and fun space for Scout. It's really important they have a place that makes them feel secure. Slowly introduce Scout to Toby and Buddy, it takes time for the pups to get used to each other too! Scout is so lucky to have you and your girlfriend! "

Andrew said, "Thanks! We feel so lucky to have Scout. It's been amazing having so many furry friends! How are your dogs doing now? "

Audrey said, "They're doing great! Exploring, meeting new people...they feel so loved and safe. I'm really glad they're part of my life!"

Andrew said, "That's great to hear! Dogs truly bring so much joy and friendship. I'm glad they're happy with you."

Audrey said, "Thanks! They're really awesome and bring so much joy and friendship. I'm so grateful to have them in my life as a part of my family."

Andrew said, "Yeah, it's great! Dogs are always there for us. We should count ourselves lucky to have such amazing furry friends as family member."




Based on the above conversations, write a short answer for the following question in a few words. Do not write complete and lengthy sentences. Answer with exact words from the conversations whenever possible.

Question: When did Audrey adopt Pixie? Use DATE of CONVERSATION to answer with an approximate date.
